_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. H2 ships as a jar on Maven Central rather than as an image, so each entry states the base CI pulls in `image` and the engine itself in `engine_artifact`, and the version is held against the artifact (docs/engine-versions.md §1). There is no usable H2 image: the only versioned community one is two release lines behind, on Java 11, and carries neither grep nor sed, which the check runner needs (all measured 2026-08-30). The baseline is the current release — H2 designates no long-term line, and the storage format is compatible across the whole 2.x series in both directions (measured), so the newest is not a moving target. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: H2

sources.h2_db: One `<database>.mv.db` file, copied while the database was closed
sources.h2_db_dir: A directory of database files; the newest by file time is restored (no H2 artifact records when it was taken)
sources.h2_backup: One `BACKUP TO` archive — H2's own online backup, consistent by construction
sources.h2_backup_dir: A directory of archives; the newest by file time is restored
